ZONINGLOTDEVELOPMENTANDEASEMENTAGREEMENT “"Agreement"), made as ofthe  day oful 202 , by and between Third Av 585 Properties LLC ("Owner"), a New York limited liability company, having an address at c/o Shemel Acquisitions,38 East 32nd Street,Room 603,NewYork,New York 10016,and BLDG East 38 Street LLC, a Delaware limited liability company, having an address at 417 Fifth Avenue, 4th Floor,NewYork,NewYork 10016("Developer"). WITNESSETH: WHEREAS,Owneris thefee owner of certain land,with thebuildings andimprovements thereon, located in the Borough of New York, City and State of New York, known as Lot 4 in Block 919 on the Tax Map of the City of New York, County of New York (the “Tax Map"), and as and by the street address 585 Third Avenue, New York, New York 10016, and more particularly described in Exhibit “A" annexed hereto and made a part hereof (the “Owner Land"; the building and improvements located thereon, and any replacement or Rebuilding (hereinafter defined) is herein referred toas the“Owner Building”;and the Owner Land and the Owner Building are herein collectively referred to as the“Owner Parcel"); WHEREAS, Developer is the fee owner of certain land, with the buildings and improvements thereon,located in the Borough of NewYork,City and State of NewYork,known as Lot 1 in Block 919 on the Tax Map,and as and by the street address 579 Third Avenue, New York, New York 10016, and more particularly described on Exhibit “B" annexed hereto and made a part hereof (the “Developer Land"; the building and improvements located thereon is herein referred to as the “Existing Developer Building"); WHEREAS, Developer may alter and vertically enlarge the Existing Developer Building and/or demolish the Existing Developer Building and construct a new building or buildings on the Developer Land and/or any Additional Parcel (as hereinafter defined), and construct other improvements associated with such new buildings (the new building(s) and improvements together with any additions thereto or future alterations thereto or replacements or Rebuilding thereof, all collectively referred to as the“Developer Building"); and the Developer Land and the Developer Building,are herein collectively referred to as the“Developer Parcel")(but in no event shall the Developer Building encroach on the Owner's lot lines as described in Exhibit“A",or cantilever over any portion of the Owner Land); WHEREAS, the Owner Building contains less floor area, as defined in the Zoning Resolution (as hereinafter defined), than is now available for use on the Owner Parcel pursuant to the Zoning Resolution,so that the Excess Development Rights (as hereinafter defined) are availablefor transfer to and utilization on theDeveloperParcel and anyAdditional Parcel; WHEREAS, it is contemplated that the Developer Building will contain more floor area than is generated by the Developer Parcel pursuant to the Zoning Resolution, and the parties hereto therefore desire to utilize the procedure available pursuant to the Zoning Resolution for the creation of the Merged Zoning Lot (as hereinafter defined) so as to make available the Excess Development Rights for utilization in the construction and maintenance of the Developer Building, and Owner is willing to make such Excess Development Rights available to Developer in perpetuity; WHEREAS,thepartieshereto are simultaneouslyherewith executing(i) aDeclaration of definition of the term “zoning lot’ in Section 12-10 of the Zoning Resolution in order to create a single zoning lot consisting of the Owner Parcel and the Developer Parcel (such zoning lot, as the same may be enlarged or subdivided in accordance with the Declaration and the terms of this Agreement, is herein referred to as the “Merged Zoning Lot"), and (ii) such other agreements, easements and licenses as are necessary to effectuate the intent of the parties in connection with this Agreement (the Declaration and such other agreements, easements and licenses are herein collectively referred to as the “Zoning Documents"); WHEREAS, all parties in interest (as defined in the Zoning Resolution) to the Merged Zoning Lot as shown on the Zoning Lot Certification of Royal Abstract of New York LLC ("Certification"), annexed hereto as Exhibit “C", have joined in the Declaration or have waived or have previously waived their right to do so and have either executed this Agreement or subordinated orpreviously subordinated thereto; and WHEREAS, the parties hereto wish to set forth certain agreements with respect to their rights and obligations in and to the Merged Zoning Lot and other matters. NOW THEREFORE, in consideration of the mutual covenants and agreements contained herein, and for other good and valuable consideration, the receipt and sufficiency of which are hereby conclusively acknowledged, the parties hereto hereby covenant and agree as follows: ARTICLE 1 CertainDefinitions.As used herein: Development Rights that may become available to the Developer Parcel or the Merged Zoning Lot, (by an expansion of the Merged Zoning Lot to include Additional Parcels (as hereinafter defined) pursuant to the provisions of the Zoning Resolution.
